course_name_original: MATH4 — RESOLUTION DE SYTEMES ALGEBRIQUES (46 h)
syllabus_topics: Resolution of algebraic and differential, linear and non-linear systems: analytical and/or numerical
Main PDEs in physics: heat, Laplace, transport, waves
Resolution methods for PDEs: Fourier, Laplace, Green, method of characteristics, spectral analysis, variational analysis
Main approximation methods: finite differences, finite elements, spectral method, optimization
Introduction to scheme analysis: consistency, precision, stability and convergence
assessment_rules: The average will be calculated proportionally to the hours.
institution: Ecole Nationale Superieure De Mecanique Et Des Microtechnique
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur ENSMM (cycle ingénieur, spécialité Mécanique) — 1.er y 2.º año
